observed.caption: Elevated view of a multi-level outdoor shopping mall courtyard with white tensile canopy sails, colorful glass storefronts, and people dining and walking on balconies and ground level.
observed.description: The photo shows an elevated, wide view looking down into a multi-level open-air shopping mall courtyard surrounded by buildings with balconies and glass railings. Large white tensile fabric canopies are stretched over upper balconies and the lower courtyard. The building on the right has multiple floors with illuminated shop interiors, colorful stained-glass windows with red, blue, yellow and green panels, and a staircase with striped steps. The building on the left and in the background has a gray facade with rectangular windows. Numerous potted plants and tall green trees are placed along balconies and in the central courtyard. Dark tables and chairs are arranged on balconies and on the paved stone courtyard floor below, with several red umbrellas shading tables. Small figures of people are visible seated at tables dining and walking on walkways and the ground floor. Warm artificial lighting from shops and balcony lights illuminates the scene against fading daylight.
